note: Automation lane AUTO1 (round 24, 2026-10-04): Body Refining Path and Subpath features, the first Path alphabetically. Each row names the printed line the table now resolves.

tianxia.subpath.body.kensei.feature.swor.name: Sword Saint Incarnation
tianxia.subpath.body.kensei.feature.swor.why: While Sword Saint Incarnation lasts, your unarmed strikes and recorded integrated Blade attacks score a Critical Hit on a d20 roll of 19 or 20. Choose the integrated weapon attack on your sheet. Other attacks retain their normal critical range.

tianxia.subpath.body.hundred_hand_battle.name: Thousand-Hand Incarnation
tianxia.subpath.body.hundred_hand_battle.why: While the incarnation lasts you gain one additional Reaction each round, spent only on Circle of Uncounted Arms (combat/ext/reaction_economy.py grant 'extra').

covers: You may use it once per round.
You may use it after learning that the saving throw failed.
You may use it only once on the same saving throw.
This bonus is not saving-throw proficiency.
tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.tempe.why: Body Refining's CL1 Tempered Response answers one failed saving throw a round for 1 Stamina and your Proficiency Bonus (combat/typed_reactions.py save_rescue, no Reaction, keyed on the chosen ability). The printed Defensive Discipline is now the fighter's own pick (combat/ext/defensive_disciplines.py), so those five procedure lines are the table's own rules and are not left for the GM. Not automated: the printed 'It does not stack with saving-throw proficiency from another source.' stays with the GM. The rescue bonus is added to the final save total, and that total already includes proficiency (combat/factory_compiler.py), so the engine cannot read whether the character is proficient; enforcing the printed restriction needs recorded save-proficiency provenance, never a numeric guess.

tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.merid.name: Meridian Reinforcement
covers: You may make this additional saving throw once per round.
tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.merid.why: Consolidates the existing Poisoned/Exhaustion save Advantage with disease Advantage and the paid end-of-turn repeat. Only an ordinary stored repeat_save contract that ends on success is eligible. Origin provenance alone, unknown source restrictions, and multiple-success diseases remain GM work; their outcome clauses are deliberately uncovered. The prior Exhaustion benefit is preserved; breathing and meridian-disruption classification remains unimplemented.
